text: You are going to investigate the effect of acid concentration on the rate of diffusion.
Bromothymol blue is an indicator that turns yellow in the presence of an acid.
Read all the instructions but DO NOT DO THEM until you have drawn a table for your results
You should use the safety equipment provided while you are doing the practical work.
Step 1 Label three beakers A1, A2 and A3.
Step 2 Add 20cm of 1 mol per dm hydrochloric acid solution to beaker A1.
Step 3 Add 2cm of 1 mol per dm hydrochloric acid solution to beaker A2.
Step 4 Add 18 cm of distilled water to the hydrochloric acid solution in beaker A2 and mix well.
Step 5 Use a clean syringe to transfer 2cm of the solution from beaker A2 to beaker A3.
Step 6 Add 18 cm of distilled water to beaker A3 and mix well. DO NOT WRITE IN THIS MARGIN
